critique: The general-b compiler does not deliver the advertised fixed-parameter accepted-output delay: its running time depends on the potentially much larger raw-witness count W, and the canonical partial-support recursion remains open. The complete polynomial-delay result is confined to b<=2, where every obstruction reduces to a bow followed by directed reachability. Reliability and sensitivity evaluation also begin only after the obstruction hypergraph and an incidence decomposition are supplied, so they are not an end-to-end efficient procedure from the uncertain envelope. The absence of an implementation, performance study, or calibrated uncertain-ADMG application further limits the projected leading-journal score. The framing accurately distinguishes these proved results from the unresolved general-b delay claim, so there is no stale overclaim.
